items.title: Pioneering Innovation in the Commercial Space Revolution
items.summary: The commercial space industry is experiencing unprecedented growth, and TTM Technologies stands at the forefront of this transformation. Goldman Sachs forecasts the satellite market to grow from $15 billion today to $108 billion by 2035 in its base-case scenario, with the most optimistic projections reaching $457 billion. As the sector expands rapidly, the demand for advanced, reliable printed circuit board solutions has never been greater.

items.title: Built to Endure: Mission-Critical Electronics for Aerospace & Defense
items.summary: In aerospace and defense, there is no margin for error. No second chances. No acceptable failure rate. The electronics that protect nations, enable warfighters, guide aircraft, support space systems, and power mission-critical platforms have to work the first time, every time, under conditions that would defeat lesser technology.

items.title: Innovative Solutions for Advanced PCB Manufacturing in Cooling Systems
items.summary: The demand for advanced electronic components is rapidly increasing across various sectors, including cooling systems for air conditioning and data centers. TTM Technologies (“TTM”) is at the forefront of this evolution by supporting the volume production of “PCB Stators” designed for the Aircore EC motor system. These systems play a crucial role in optimizing energy efficiency for applications such as air conditioning and mobility motors, including propulsion and auxiliary motors. Recently, we made a significant impact by helping a customer navigate challenges in their PCB design process.

items.title: Navigating Supply Chain Challenges with TTM Technologies
items.summary: In the growing industrial automation landscape, clients increasingly seek innovative and reliable partners to address their supply chain challenges. TTM Technologies (“TTM”) has positioned itself as a key player, focusing on enhancing operational capabilities while ensuring sustainability in sourcing. items.title: Advancing Medical Device Manufacturing with TTM Technologies
items.summary: The medical device industry is experiencing rapid technological advancements and an increasing demand for innovative solutions. As healthcare systems evolve and medical equipment becomes more sophisticated, manufacturers are under pressure to deliver high-quality, reliable products at competitive prices. Among these innovations, flexible printed circuit boards (“PCB”s) have emerged as critical components, especially in devices that require compact and lightweight designs.
